basic_profile.bio: I'm a 30-year-old tech enthusiast and cryptocurrency hobbyist living in Toronto, Canada. I work as a software developer by day and enjoy diving into the world of blockchain and altcoins during my free time. My interests include exploring new music genres, with a special fondness for My Chemical Romance. I also enjoy binge-watching classic TV shows like 'Sex and the City'. I'm currently single and usually online during late evenings, GMT-5, after a long day of coding.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over 8 years. I got into cryptocurrencies about a year and a half ago, mostly through self-teaching and active participation in online forums and subreddits. I'm particularly interested in new blockchain technologies and their potential applications.
